thesis: Pre-open news pack is thin and mostly generic single-name/sector aggregator noise (AI/data-center chatter, Alphabet capital raise, gold holding range, misc earnings) with no clear, actionable macro catalyst for a conservative core-ETF sleeve. Consistent with capital-preservation mandate, holding rather than chasing headlines; existing VTI core position (~15% of equity) and cash buffer (~85%) stay unchanged. Will resume adding to the core sleeve when the pack offers a stronger, non-speculative signal.
